summary: Iteration 71 - Testing Loyalty Program, Duty Manager Logbook, and Occupancy Forecasting. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI components verified working. Fixed SelectItem empty value bug in LogbookPanel.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

endpoints_tested: GET /api/loyalty/leaderboard/{property_id} - Returns members sorted by lifetime_points with tier_counts ✓
GET /api/loyalty/member/{guest_id} - Returns member details with tier, points, benefits, next tier info ✓
POST /api/loyalty/earn-points - Awards points with tier multiplier, auto-upgrades tier ✓
POST /api/loyalty/redeem - Redeems points for reward, validates balance ✓
POST /api/logbook/entries - Creates logbook entry with type, priority, shift ✓
GET /api/logbook/entries/{property_id} - Lists entries with optional shift/date filter ✓
POST /api/logbook/shift-handover - Creates handover with key_items and pending_issues arrays ✓
GET /api/forecast/occupancy/{property_id}?days=90 - Returns forecast with daily data and 7/30/90-day summaries ✓

Authentication required for all protected endpoints ✓

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 71 tested 3 new modules: Loyalty Program, Duty Manager Logbook, and Occupancy Forecasting. All backend APIs and frontend UIs working correctly. Loyalty is under GUEST EXPERIENCE in sidebar, Logbook and Forecast are under OPERATIONS. Fixed SelectItem empty value bug in LogbookPanel. Loyalty members are created from guest_profiles - sync profiles first via POST /api/guests/profiles/sync/{property_id}, then get member via GET /api/loyalty/member/{guest_id}.

mocked_apis.note: All APIs are real backend endpoints connected to MongoDB
